description: Starts an AI analysis job that finds the themes in the responses. type='hierarchy' builds the L1-L3 category hierarchy and CHARGES CREDITS (1 per valid response, once per project); type='categorization' assigns every response to the hierarchy (no extra charge). Call only after the user agreed to the price and model from open_end_estimate_analysis; pass the model of the requested step as expected_model (models.hierarchy.model for type='hierarchy', models.categorization.model for type='categorization') and the agreed price as max_credits. Returns a run id immediately; poll it with open_end_get_run. Do not start a second run while one is active. Requires OAuth or an API key with analysis:run.

expected_model.description: Model of THIS step from open_end_estimate_analysis: models.hierarchy.model for type='hierarchy', models.categorization.model for type='categorization'.

hierarchy_id.description: For categorization; defaults to the newest hierarchy.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (e.g. a UUID). Repeating the call with the same key and arguments returns the original result instead of writing again. Without it, identical calls within about 10 minutes are deduplicated.

max_credits.description: Upper price limit the user agreed to.

name: open_end_start_run
title: Start an analysis run
